entities.summary: The Kyūdai Main Line  is a railway line in Kyushu, Japan, operated by the Kyushu Railway Company. It connects Kurume Station, Kurume in Fukuoka Prefecture and Ōita Station, Ōita in Ōita Prefecture. It is also known as the Yufu Kōgen Line.
